visual_action: A two-part video in a meme format. The first part, labeled "Trump before the election:", shows a split screen. In the top panel, a man in a suit (Lex Fridman) speaks. In the bottom panel, Donald Trump speaks into a microphone in what appears to be a podcast or interview setting, with an American flag in the background. The second part, labeled "Trump after the election:", shows another split screen. In the top panel, Donald Trump looks on during a meeting. In the bottom panel, he is seated at a table next to another man (Marco Rubio) and is speaking with his hands.

central_claim: Donald Trump hypocritically promised to release Jeffrey Epstein's client list before the election but became dismissive of the topic afterward.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as untrustworthy and hypocritical regarding the Jeffrey Epstein case.
